hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading (e.g., 'The right framework, built correctly'). Max 6 words.

h1.h1-text: Primary comparison title prefix (e.g., 'LangChain vs LlamaIndex development services:').
h1.span: Value proposition or core focus suffix (e.g., 'the right RAG framework'). Max 6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph explaining how choosing between the two tools affects cost, velocity, and architecture. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Cred highlight text (e.g., '5+ yrs production RAG', 'Both frameworks, used correctly', '48h architecture rec.'). Max 5 words.

btn-primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Get a framework recommendation'). Max 4 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Trust note about written deliverables and discovery commitment. Max 1 sentence.

trust.span: Metric explanation (e.g., 'Years building production RAG', 'Less code, LlamaIndex vs baseline', 'To a written recommendation').
